rows.title: Camera Viewpoints
rows.note: Most brittle among the completed local categories; camera pose changes strongly affect visual grounding.

rows.title: Robot Initial States
rows.note: Moderate robustness; failures often come from approach pose and grasp recovery sensitivity.

rows.title: Light Conditions
rows.note: Highest success among completed local categories; illumination shifts are less damaging than geometry/language changes.

rows.title: Background Textures
rows.note: Texture/domain shift stresses visual appearance; failures are useful for checking whether policy overfits tabletop/background cues.

rows.title: Language Instructions
rows.note: Language paraphrase/instruction shift directly tests semantic grounding; low score usually indicates instruction following and target disambiguation errors.

rows.title: Objects Layout
rows.note: Object layout changes stress spatial search, grasp approach, and collision recovery; failures often expose planning rather than pure perception issues.
